Title 3: Select the authoritative Build OS backlog
Description:
USE CASE
  • The delivery owner needs one coherent source backlog so that the Azure tree does not mix unrelated revisions or blocked work.

DESCRIPTION
  • Read the selected work index and all listed phase files.
  • Stop when backlog authority or scope is unclear.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
  • t1: Read the work-directory routing instructions.
    • Read docs/work/AGENTS.md before source selection.
  • t2: Reconcile the index Phase Map with the phase files.
    • Record missing or extra phase files as blockers.
    • Preserve candidate, superseded, and approval-gate language.
Acceptance Criteria:
• One work directory is selected as the export source.
  • The source inventory is complete so that:
    • every Phase Map entry resolves to one phase file;
    • every selected stage has tasks and acceptance criteria.
  • Candidate or superseded work is not presented as executable authority.

Title 3: Rewrite stage content into Azure rich text
Description:
USE CASE
  • Azure Boards users need consistent rich-text fields so that each work item separates its reason, outcome, and implementation detail.

DESCRIPTION
  • Create the required Description sections.
  • Rewrite source acceptance bullets as observable end states.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
  • t1: Write USE CASE, DESCRIPTION, and TECHNICAL DETAILS once and in that order.
  • t2: Preserve task IDs, paths, commands, dependencies, and gates.
  • t3: Add the BUILD OS SOURCE trace to Design Notes.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The Description contains all three required sections in the required order.
  • The Acceptance Criteria field contains an HTML unordered list of observable end states.
  • The Design Notes field contains the source work directory, phase file, stage, and task IDs.

Title 3: Emit and validate the hierarchical import CSV
Description:
USE CASE
  • The delivery owner needs one import-ready CSV so that Azure Boards can create the full parent-child tree without manual repair.

DESCRIPTION
  • Emit the selected Azure Boards CSV profile.
  • Validate the complete file before delivery.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
  • t4: Emit the target profile.
    • Write UTF-8 with a byte-order mark.
    • Write rows in Epic, Feature, and Product Backlog Item preorder.
  • t5: Run structural validation.
    • Reject invalid title hierarchy.
    • Reject missing HTML sections or source traces.
    • Reject populated ID, State, or Assigned To values in a new-item profile.
Acceptance Criteria:
• The CSV starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark.
  • Each row populates exactly one Title 1-4 field.
  • The validator exits with status 0 for the synthetic golden file.
  • No new-item row contains an ID, state, or assigned-user value.
